description: Botswana Power Corporation issues warehouse receipt tokens backed by commodities produced or procured by the enterprise. Token holders receive pro-rata claims on certified stored inventory, enabling smallholder suppliers to access immediate liquidity.
regulatoryFramework: Botswana Privatisation Agency Act; NBFIRA Digital Asset Guidelines

tokenName: Botswana Power Corporation Workforce Service Contract Token

description: Botswana Power Corporation tokenises service contracts with suppliers and independent contractors. Micro-enterprises and artisans can tokenise outstanding invoices as collateral for working-capital loans, eliminating the 90-day government payment delay.
regulatoryFramework: Botswana Privatisation Agency Act; NBFIRA Digital Asset Guidelines

tokenName: Botswana Power Corporation Infrastructure PPP Token
underlyingAsset: Public-private partnership project in Botswana — managed by Botswana Power Corporation with mandatory 60% local employment quota
description: Botswana Power Corporation issues PPP tokens for capital infrastructure projects. Each token represents fractional participation in project revenue under a concession agreement. Smart contracts automatically enforce local hiring targets before milestone payments are released.
regulatoryFramework: Botswana Privatisation Agency Act; NBFIRA Digital Asset Guidelines

tokenName: Botswana Power Corporation Public Real Estate Asset Token
underlyingAsset: Government-owned land and property portfolio managed by Botswana Power Corporation in Botswana
description: Botswana Power Corporation tokenises government property assets to unlock dormant balance-sheet value. Citizens can invest from 1 BWP unit and earn rental income proportional to token holdings, converting public assets into inclusive wealth-generation instruments.
regulatoryFramework: Botswana Privatisation Agency Act; NBFIRA Digital Asset Guidelines

tokenName: Botswana Power Corporation Verified Labour Proof-of-Work Token

description: Botswana Power Corporation issues proof-of-work tokens for every verified day of labour performed by casual workers on government contracts. Accumulated tokens build a portable credit score accepted by partner lenders, replacing the collateral requirement for the unbanked workforce.
regulatoryFramework: Botswana Privatisation Agency Act; NBFIRA Digital Asset Guidelines

tokenName: Botswana Power Corporation Capital Project Milestone Token

description: Botswana Power Corporation issues milestone tokens that unlock progress payments only when independent inspectors verify project completion at each gate. This eliminates corruption in public procurement and ensures employment-creating contractors are paid promptly and fairly.
regulatoryFramework: Botswana Privatisation Agency Act; NBFIRA Digital Asset Guidelines

description: Botswana Power Corporation tokenises forward purchase agreements with smallholder farmers who supply the enterprise. Farmers receive pre-season financing in token form, redeemable at harvest. This removes predatory middlemen and connects subsistence farmers to institutional buyers.
regulatoryFramework: Botswana Privatisation Agency Act; NBFIRA Digital Asset Guidelines

description: Botswana Power Corporation tokenises the economic value of SME contracts under its preferential procurement programme. Tokens can be listed on the national digital exchange, enabling impact investors to co-fund local businesses while earning competitive returns.

regulatoryFramework: Botswana Privatisation Agency Act; NBFIRA Digital Asset Guidelines

description: Botswana Power Corporation tokenises government-guaranteed development bonds accessible from 1 BWP unit. Proceeds finance electrification, water, transport or ICT expansion projects. Quarterly coupon payments are streamed directly to token holders' wallets in real time.

description: Botswana Power Corporation tokenises the mineral royalty stream from government-owned resource operations. Every citizen holding a royalty token receives a direct share of natural resource revenue, converting extractive industry profits into universal basic wealth distribution.
